clue.text: It suggests the possibility of power

definitions.meaning: a modal verb used to say something could happen, as in 'it could rain'
strength or force, as in 'with all one's strength'

explanation.surface: A remark that something hints at potential strength.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it expresses possibility; as a noun it is a synonym for strength or force.

clue.text: Garbled verse about finishing off pasta

definitions.note: the clue phrase is a noun, the answer an adjective describing such verse

indicators.note: the second piece comes at the end, completing the first

parts.note: macaroni is a tube-shaped pasta
C is short for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Muddled poetry concerning the last of the pasta.
explanation.definitionFit: Describes burlesque poetry mixing vernacular words with Latin endings, a jumbled jargon.

clue.text: Lag involved with Welsh buccaneer in Wales

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so the letters of the word before it are jumbled

parts.note: Sir Henry Morgan was a Welsh privateer of the 17th century

explanation.surface: A convict teams up with a pirate from Cardiff way.
explanation.definitionFit: A historic county of south Wales, home to Cardiff and Swansea.

clue.text: Spanish wine put up by the pitcher

definitions.meaning: a deep red sweet wine from Spain, once used for communion
a camper pitches and erects canvas shelter

explanation.surface: A bottle of Rioja set out by the baseball thrower.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for a red Spanish wine; also the canvas shelter a camper pitches.

clue.text: Game Nubian knave

parts.note: a Nubian is a dark-skinned African, hence black in old crossword usage
the knave is the jack in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: A game naming a Nubian jack, like a playing card.
explanation.definitionFit: A casino card game, also called twenty-one or pontoon.

clue.text: Become disenchanted with solving anagrams

definitions.meaning: to be freed from a magic charm
an anagram is solved by undoing the jumbled spelling

explanation.surface: Lose one's fascination with unscrambling words.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for ending enchantment; literally, cracking the jumbled spelling of a word.

clue.text: Ken pronounced a veto

indicators.note: pronounced means spoken, so a word's sound is what counts

parts.note: a no is a refusal or veto

explanation.surface: A man named Kenneth declared a ban.
explanation.definitionFit: Ken is a Scots verb meaning be aware of or understand.

clue.text: A tax popular with punters

parts.note: scot is an old word for a tax, as in scot-free

explanation.surface: A levy that gamblers like.
explanation.walkthrough: PUNTERS are British slang for gamblers; ASCOT is a famous racecourse in Berkshire.
explanation.definitionFit: A Berkshire racecourse, a favourite venue for gamblers on horses.

clue.text: Anchor a king over the border

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: K is the chess and card abbreviation for king
an edge is a border or rim

explanation.surface: A monarch is moored just across the frontier.
explanation.definitionFit: A small anchor used for warping a ship along.

clue.text: Links formed by having tea at home

parts.note: cha is a colloquial word for tea
in means at home, as in 'staying in'

explanation.surface: Golf links created by people taking tea at home.
explanation.definitionFit: A series of connected rings or loops, so a set of links joined together.

clue.text: The head in consequence has become firmly established

indicators.note: the word in tells us one piece is set inside the other

parts.note: an end is an outcome or result
sconce is an old jocular word for the head

explanation.surface: Someone's leader, in consequence, has become settled in place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head' looks like a leader, but here it is an old jocular word for the skull; 'in' puts it inside the result word.
explanation.definitionFit: Settled snugly and securely in a place or position.

clue.text: Corporal punishment for hefty lads

definitions.meaning: beating children with a leather strap
big strong young men

explanation.surface: Discipline by beating for well-built youths.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally belting the youngsters with a leather band; also a phrase for burly young men.

clue.text: Cheat in a chess game

definitions.meaning: to swindle or defraud someone
a castle-shaped piece found in a chess game

explanation.surface: Someone cheats during a chess match.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means swindle; as a noun it is the castle piece on a chessboard.

clue.text: Go in for winter sports with the right attire

parts.note: to ski is to take part in a winter sport
RT is a standard abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Take up winter sports wearing the proper clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A garment hanging from the waist, an item of clothing.

clue.text: Viewer's complaint in the middle of last year

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the run of words last year, straddling the gap

explanation.surface: Someone's eye trouble halfway through the previous year.
explanation.definitionFit: An inflamed swelling on the eyelid, an ailment of one who sees.

clue.text: Spring is beginning

definitions.meaning: to jump suddenly, as with a jolt of surprise
the commencement of something

explanation.surface: The season of spring is just arriving.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden jump of surprise; also the outset of anything.

clue.text: Domestic squabble is a bit of an act

definitions.meaning: a noisy row, as in 'make a fuss'
a division of an act in a play

explanation.surface: A family quarrel is partly theatrical.
explanation.definitionFit: A public fuss or row; also a subdivision of a play's act.

clue.text: Understand how to be successful at an art auction

definitions.meaning: to grasp what is going on

definitions.text: how to be successful at an art auction
definitions.meaning: winning the bidding means you obtain the painting

explanation.surface: Grasp the secret of winning at a sale of paintings.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom meaning grasp the situation; literally, acquire the painting being sold.

clue.text: Illiterate leader nun converted

indicators.note: converted means changed into another form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A head of a convent who cannot read has changed faith.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking education or schooling, unable to read.

clue.text: Credit given for using a simple vocabulary

definitions.meaning: instalment payment arrangements offered by a shop
plain words that are not hard to understand

explanation.surface: Praise awarded for writing in plain language.
explanation.definitionFit: A hire-purchase deal with gentle repayments; literally, uncomplicated words.

clue.text: Censoring also reform of the US legislature

indicators.note: to reform is to reshape, so the letters of the words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Censorship is also a matter of reforming America's lawmakers.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to Congress, the American national lawmaking body.

clue.text: Plenty of people bid for them

definitions.meaning: a large amount, as in 'heaps'
items offered at an auction, each sold separately

explanation.surface: A great many buyers make bids at a sale.
explanation.definitionFit: Colloquially a great deal; also the numbered items in an auction sale.

clue.text: Greek letter to colonel upset the medico

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the joined pieces read from bottom to top

parts.note: mu is the twelfth letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A character from the Greek alphabet upsets an army officer and the doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'upset' reverses the joined pieces, so they read from the bottom up.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand-in doctor covering for a GP who is away.

clue.text: Article of faith unaffected by uprising

indicators.note: in a down clue, reading the word from the bottom upward changes nothing, so it reads the same both ways

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A belief that stays firm despite a rebellion.
explanation.definitionFit: A principle or doctrine held as true.

clue.text: Sound way for the dieter to check progress

definitions.text: for the dieter to check progress

indicators.note: the word Sound at the front says the next word is said out loud

parts.note: a way is a route or method

explanation.surface: A healthy method for slimmers to monitor their improvement.
explanation.definitionFit: Slimmers measure their heaviness on scales to see how the diet is going.

clue.text: Some character

definitions.meaning: a portion, as in 'in some measure'
a role played by an actor

explanation.surface: A remark that someone is quite an odd person.
explanation.definitionFit: A portion of a whole; also an actor's role in a play.

clue.text: Principal memorial of Titus

definitions.meaning: chief, as in an ...-enemy
the triumphal monument to the emperor Titus in the Roman Forum

explanation.surface: The main monument to a Roman emperor.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means chief; the Arch of Titus is a triumphal monument in Rome.

clue.text: The likelihood is that they're not evens

definitions.meaning: the probability of something happening, as in betting
numbers like one, three and five that are not divisible by two

explanation.surface: Probably they're not equal betting prices.
explanation.definitionFit: Betting chances or probability; also the uneven whole numbers.

clue.text: Woman's voice offers love to Nicaraguan rebel lieutenant

parts.note: the Contras were rebels fighting Nicaragua's Sandinista government in the 1980s
love is zero in tennis, hence the letter O

explanation.surface: A singer offers affection to a guerrilla officer from Central America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'offers love to' places the zero after the rebel and officer, at the end of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The lowest female singing range, a deep register for a female singer.

clue.text: He presents a fellow with the alternative

parts.note: a don is a fellow of a college at Oxford or Cambridge
or is the word that introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A man gives a college colleague the other choice.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who gives something, a giver of gifts or blood.

clue.text: Incomparable advice to the over-zealous marriage bureau

definitions.meaning: without equal, peerless

definitions.text: advice to the over-zealous marriage bureau
definitions.meaning: an agency pairing too many couples might be told to pair fewer

explanation.surface: Peerless guidance for an overkeen dating agency.
explanation.definitionFit: Having no equal; read as a phrase, a plea for fewer pairings.

clue.text: They're taken by fans of football teams

definitions.text: They're taken by fans of football teams

parts.words: They're taken by fans of football teams
parts.note: supporters choose which team to back, and the teams themselves are what is chosen

explanation.surface: Supporters of soccer clubs choose allegiances.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking a position in a contest; the teams are themselves the opposing camps.
